title: ZAPS: Family Caregivers and Spirituality
summary: The study develops and examines an intervention for family caregivers that supports them in experiencing their spirituality. The effectiveness of the intervention will be assessed by questionnaires before, during, shortly after, and six months after the intervention to measure various health indicators in the family caregivers (e.g., spiritual well-being, life satisfaction). Individual family caregivers will also be interviewed to understand their experiences with the counseling course.
conditions: Spiritual well-being and stress in home care

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
a) they are caring for a relative in a domestic setting
b) have sufficient knowledge of German to understand the informed consent and the spiritual intervention
c) sign the written consent to participate in the study (Informed Consent)
Exclusion criteria:
a) they are minors
b) are legally cared for themselves
c) participate in another intervention study to promote spiritual well-being or life satisfaction.
